causal_chain.description: create_purchase_order timed out on the client side.
The agent retried the identical request without checking whether the first attempt had already succeeded server-side.
The retry carried no idempotency key, so the backend had no way to recognize it as a duplicate of the first attempt.
Missing idempotency protection on the order-creation tool integration.
Attach a stable idempotency key per user intent; have the backend deduplicate on it and return the original order on a repeat.

root_cause.root_cause: Missing idempotency protection on the order-creation tool integration
contributing_factors: No check of prior tool-call outcome before retrying

observed_impact: 10 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Duplicate real-world purchase orders -- risk of double-shipping and inventory overcommitment.
Unnecessary spend if the duplicate order is fulfilled before being caught.

remediation.recommendation: Require an idempotency key on every order-creating tool call; dedupe on it server-side.
Before retrying a timed-out call, check whether the prior attempt actually succeeded rather than assuming it failed.
Alert on any two order-creation calls with identical parameters within a short time window.

clusters.label: Silent tool failures (error caught, never surfaced)

causal_chain.description: A tool call returned an explicit error or a success:false payload.
The agent's next message to the user did not surface the error in any form.
No validation step checks a tool's response status before the agent narrates an outcome to the user.
Missing tool-result verification between the tool call and the agent's response generation.
Require an explicit success/failure check on every tool response before the agent is allowed to claim an outcome.

root_cause.root_cause: Missing tool-result verification before the agent narrates an outcome
contributing_factors: No guardrail blocking a success claim after an error

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Customer or downstream system receives false confirmation of an action that did not happen.
Errors go untracked, so the same failure can recur silently and repeatedly.

remediation.recommendation: Standardize tool responses to always include an explicit success/failure field; never rely on the absence of an error field.
Add a guardrail step that blocks a 'success' narration if the paired tool response indicates failure.
Log every case where a tool error is followed by a non-error agent message.

causal_chain.description: The tool returned a specific value (e.g. a quantity or status).
The agent's stated claim to the user does not match that value.
The agent's response is generated without grounding-checking it against the tool's actual payload.
No verification step compares the agent's claim to the tool's raw response before the message is sent.
Add a post-generation check that every stated fact traces back to a specific field in a tool response.

root_cause.root_cause: No grounding check between the agent's claim and the tool's raw response

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Business decisions (restocking, order confirmation) made on fabricated data.
Erodes trust in the agent once a customer discovers the discrepancy.

remediation.recommendation: Add a post-generation grounding check comparing every stated fact to the actual tool response before sending.
Instruct the agent explicitly to quote or reference the tool's returned value rather than paraphrasing from memory.
Sample and audit agent claims against tool payloads on a recurring basis.

clusters.label: No-progress search loop (stuck re-querying, never resolved)

causal_chain.description: The agent called the same read-only tool with identical parameters multiple times.
No new information was gained between calls, and no answer was ever surfaced to the user.
The agent has no mechanism to recognize it already has the answer it keeps re-fetching.
Missing repeated-call detection / no working-memory check before issuing a tool call.
Cache tool results within a conversation and check for an identical prior call before issuing a new one.

root_cause.root_cause: Missing repeated-call detection before issuing a tool call

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Wasted tool-call cost and latency with no resolution for the user.
User-facing delay that can itself become a frustration signal.

remediation.recommendation: Cache tool results within a conversation; check for an identical prior call before issuing a new one.
Detect and alert on 3+ identical read-only tool calls within one conversation.

clusters.label: Wrong tool/target selected (right intent, wrong record)

causal_chain.description: The user named a specific entity (e.g. a supplier).
The tool was called against a different entity's ID than the one requested.
Entity resolution (matching a name to the correct ID) is not verified before the tool call is issued.
Weak or missing entity-resolution/disambiguation step ahead of tool invocation.
Confirm the resolved entity's name back to the user (or check it against the request) before calling the tool.

root_cause.root_cause: Weak entity resolution ahead of tool invocation
contributing_factors: No confirmation of resolved entity before tool call

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Information or actions applied to the wrong customer/supplier/order record.
Potential data-privacy exposure if one party's data is surfaced to another.

remediation.recommendation: Confirm the resolved entity (name/ID) back to the user before issuing the tool call.
Return a human-readable entity name alongside the ID in lookup responses, so mismatches are visible.
Add fuzzy-match warnings when a resolved entity's name is a close-but-not-exact match to the request.

causal_chain.description: The user stated a constraint earlier in the conversation (e.g. a target warehouse).
A later tool call used a different value for that same field, with no acknowledgment of the change.
Earlier-conversation constraints are not carried forward into later tool-call parameter construction.
Missing or weak conversation-state management across turns.
Maintain an explicit running state of user-specified constraints and diff tool-call parameters against it before calling.

root_cause.root_cause: Missing or weak conversation-state management across turns
contributing_factors: No diff/confirmation when a tracked value changes

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Order fulfilled against terms the user did not actually agree to (e.g. wrong warehouse).
Requires manual correction once discovered, adding operational overhead.

remediation.recommendation: Maintain an explicit running record of user-stated constraints and diff tool-call parameters against it before calling.
Require the agent to restate any changed constraint explicitly rather than silently applying a default.
Flag tool calls whose parameters conflict with an earlier user-stated value in the same conversation.

causal_chain.description: The user rephrased or pushed back on the same request across multiple turns.
The agent's responses did not resolve the request on the first or second attempt.
The agent may be misunderstanding intent, or requiring information the user has already provided.
Possible intent-understanding gap or redundant clarification requests -- cannot be fully confirmed from conversational text alone.
Log repeated-rephrasing patterns for human review; consider escalation after N unresolved attempts.

root_cause.root_cause: Possible intent-understanding gap or redundant clarification (not fully confirmable from text alone)
contributing_factors: No escalation path after repeated attempts

observed_impact: 3 occurrence(s) detected in the analyzed conversations.
potential_impact: Degraded user experience even when the task eventually completes.
Repeated unresolved friction may correlate with support escalations or churn.

remediation.recommendation: Escalate to a human or a clarifying-question fallback after two unresolved rephrasing attempts.
Track rephrasing-frequency as a standing UX health metric, independent of task completion.
